issues.problem: ctx5 had a master losing a match. A loss can come from a stronger opponent, so it does not clearly show an expert's slip.
issues.action: Rewrote it so the master makes a basic mistake (初歩的なミス); the English now matches.

issues.problem: ctx1 gave a closed shortcut (工事中) as the reason. With the route closed there is no choice, so this is not choosing the safe way over a risky shortcut. Its English, 'better safe than sorry', was also off.
issues.action: Made the shortcut narrow and easy to get lost on, and changed the English to 'more haste, less speed'.

issues.problem: ctx4 (skipping testing) was nearly the same as the cue (skipping testing to ship faster), so the cue gave the answer away.
issues.action: Replaced it with assembling something without reading the instructions.

issues.problem: Story check: the poem attributed to the renga poet Sōchō, もののふの矢橋の船は速けれど急がば回れ瀬田の長橋. The fast boat from Yabase, the risky winds off Hiei and the longer, surer Seta bridge all match the traditional telling.
ctx2 (何度失敗しても大丈夫) could just as well take 失敗は成功のもと from the same set. ctx3 (three bankrupt companies, then a fourth) repeated the cue.
issues.action: ctx2 now centres on falling and getting up again (何度転んでも、また立ち上がればいい). ctx3 is now failing entrance exams and job hunting, then making a dream come true.

issues.problem: ctx2 (入社してまだ二か月) repeated the cue (a new hire wanting to quit after two months).
issues.action: Changed it to wanting to quit a school club (部活) early.

issues.problem: ctx1 (wondering why someone is late, then they arrive) repeated the cue.
issues.action: Changed it to remarking that Tanaka hasn't been seen lately just before Tanaka appears. The English no longer assumes a gender.

issues.problem: Story check: Book of Han, biography of Zhao Chongguo. Emperor Xuan asks the elderly general how to deal with the Qiang revolt and how many troops he needs, and he replies 百聞不如一見 and asks to go to the frontier himself. This matches the source.
ctx3 (father's fake antique vase) was the same situation as the cue.
issues.action: Replaced it with shoppers delighted by 'sale' prices that are really the usual prices.

issues.problem: ctx4 (questioning whether a meeting is needed) repeated the cue (the boss cancelling a pointless meeting).
issues.action: Changed it to cutting chat short to get back to work.

issues.problem: Story check: Franklin, Advice to a Young Tradesman (1748), 'Remember that time is money', with the ten-shilling example. The summary matches the text, and the Japanese saying is widely described as a translation of the English proverb.

Checked meaning, lit, register, tone, how, near, parts, misuses and furigana on every card. Nothing wrong was found beyond the context changes above. The null stories for 猿も木から落ちる, 七転び八起き, 石の上にも三年, 塵も積もれば山となる, 花より団子, 噂をすれば影 and 知らぬが仏 are appropriate: there is no single origin story I can stand behind.
issues.action: No change. id, t, r, mean, lvl and tag are unchanged; the list file was not touched.
